title: The Bright Creative
description: A cheerful young man with warm-brown skin, short dark curls, a broad natural smile, small hoop earrings, and a mustard-and-navy plaid shirt. Friendly, approachable energy; close-up portrait against a warm neutral studio backdrop with soft, even light.

title: The Quiet Thinker
description: A thoughtful young man with medium warm skin, voluminous dark curly hair, subtle stubble, and a charcoal crew-neck shirt. Calm, direct expression; centered studio headshot against a deep charcoal background with soft directional lighting.

title: The Editorial Original
description: A young man with warm medium-brown skin, dense natural curls, and a simple black crew-neck shirt. Composed, confident expression; tightly framed editorial portrait with dramatic side lighting and a pale studio background.
